text: Domain 2 covers moving data into Fabric and reshaping it once it's there — pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, Eventstreams, notebooks, and the Spark transformations underneath.

Nightly scheduled batch loads with retries point to a pipeline. Low-code transform-as-you-load points to Dataflow Gen2. Continuous events point to an Eventstream. Custom PySpark logic points to a notebook.

Every write into a Lakehouse table lands as a Delta table under OneLake, no matter which tool wrote it — schema enforcement is silently in effect, rejecting a mismatched write rather than corrupting data.
Eventstreams feed Eventhouse and KQL databases, or route straight into a Lakehouse. Fixed five-minute, non-overlapping aggregation buckets is describing a tumbling window by definition.
Pipelines orchestrate; notebooks and Dataflows are often steps inside them, not competitors. Next up: Domain 3 — monitoring and optimizing a solution.
